hero.title: An assistant to help you take your medications
hero.lead: Pilbo is a virtual pill box designed for people who take a lot of medications and sometimes forget a dose. It reminds you of each intake, until it is done.
hero.betaTitle: Pilbo is in beta, feel free to try it!
hero.note: Free, with no ads and no account. Your data stays on your phone.
hero.screenshotAlt: Pilbo’s Today screen: a low stock alert, the 12:20 intake running late with a magnesium tablet to take with meals, then the 8:20 PM intake.

features.title: What Pilbo does
features.lead: Pilbo makes managing your medications simple: your intakes, your reminders and your stock.

pillbox.title: A virtual pill box
pillbox.text: Organize your intakes at different times, each with its medications and quantities. You can choose the days and recurrence of each intake independently.
pillbox.screenshotAlt: The Pillbox screen: intakes at 8:20, 12:20, 8:20 PM and 10 PM, each with its medications.

reminders.title: Discreet reminders
reminders.text: A discreet notification every 10 minutes, instead of an alarm you turn off without taking your medications. Confirm the intake right from the notification, and choose the sound of your reminders.
reminders.screenshotAlt: Editing the 8:20 intake: time, days, reminder repeated every 10 minutes, sound and medications.

appearance.title: A touch of color
appearance.text: Customize the shape, size and colors of your medications to recognize them at a glance. Tablet, capsule, sachet, syrup or drops: each one has its shape.
appearance.screenshotAlt: Customizing a pill: a pink and lilac capsule, with a choice of ten shapes, including sachet, syrup and drops.

stocks.title: No more empty boxes
stocks.text: Track the stock of the medications that matter to you. Each intake lowers it automatically, and a notification lets you know before you run out.
stocks.screenshotAlt: The Meds screen: magnesium is running low, 4 days left, while vitamin D will last 46 and 56 more days.

calendar.title: The history of your intakes
calendar.text: View your intakes in a calendar: the days when everything was taken, the late intakes and the forgotten ones.
calendar.screenshotAlt: The calendar of the month: most days are checked, a few intakes were late or missed.

privacy.title: Your data stays on your phone
privacy.text: No account, no server, no ads and no collection of your data. Pilbo works without an internet connection, and it is an open source project.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.text: Pilbo is designed to follow the WCAG / RAAM guidelines as closely as possible, and tested with screen readers and large text sizes. It has not been audited yet, but if you notice an accessibility issue, feel free to write to us at pilbo@tentacode.dev.

platforms.title: On iPhone and Android
platforms.text: Pilbo is available on iPhone and Android, in English and French. It is completely free.

cta.title: Try Pilbo!
cta.text: The beta is open: you can install Pilbo now. Your feedback is valuable and will help us improve it before its release.

beta.title: Join the Pilbo beta
beta.lead: Pilbo is not available in the stores yet. The beta lets you use it now, and your feedback helps us improve it before its release.
beta.dataText: Your data will not be lost: when Pilbo is released, you can install the final version and find your medications, intakes and history as they were.
beta.feedbackText: Try adding your intakes, taking one from a reminder notification and tracking a stock. If something feels off, write to us at pilbo@tentacode.dev, with a screenshot if possible.

ios.title: On iPhone
ios.intro: The beta goes through TestFlight, Apple’s app for testing apps. Two steps:
ios.step1Text: TestFlight is free, on the App Store.
ios.step2Text: Open this link on your iPhone, then tap “Accept” and “Install”.
ios.note: Updates arrive in TestFlight. Pilbo then opens like any other app.

android.title: On Android
android.intro: The beta goes through the Play Store. Two steps, in this order:
android.step1Text: This Google group gives you access to the test.
android.step2Text: Tap “Become a tester”, then install Pilbo from the Play Store.
android.step2Button: Sign up for the Android test
android.note: Use the same Google account as the Play Store on your phone for both steps. Pilbo may take a few minutes to show up after you sign up.

support.title: Need help?
support.lead: A question, a problem or an idea? Write to us, we will answer you.
support.tip1: Try to describe what happened, and what you expected.
support.tip3: Tell us your phone model, and the version of Pilbo (in Settings).

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: Pilbo collects no data. Everything you enter stays on your phone. This policy applies to Pilbo on iPhone and Android.
privacy.noDataText: Pilbo has no account and no server. Your medications, intakes, stocks and history are only stored on your phone. We never receive them, and we cannot see them.
privacy.offlineText: Pilbo works without an internet connection.
privacy.trackingText: Pilbo shows no advertising, does not measure your use of the app and does not track you. It contains no third-party service that collects data.
privacy.notificationsText: Reminders are scheduled by Pilbo directly on your phone. They do not go through any server.
privacy.backupsText: Pilbo sends nothing by itself. If backup is turned on on your phone (iCloud or Google), your phone may include Pilbo’s data in it, as for your other apps. These backups are handled by Apple or Google, in your account. We have no access to them.
privacy.deletionText: Uninstalling Pilbo deletes all its data from your phone.
privacy.changesText: If this policy changes, we will update this page and its date at the top.
privacy.contactText: A question about this policy? Write to us at pilbo@tentacode.dev.
